In Aether Archipelago, build an olive tandem-rotor Chinook transport.

Use a dynamic fuselage, hollow cabin, readable cockpit, landing wheels, and a functional pilot seat. Put two counter-rotating rotors in separate components.

Implement simplified flight with thrust and torque: W/S forward and reverse, A/D turn, Space/Shift climb and descend. Tilt to accelerate; stabilize when input is released.

Switch to Nature and confirm this world's identifier and placement.

Build a sand-colored four-wheel off-road vehicle with a pilot seat, visible headlights, roof rack, and generous ground clearance.

Use a dynamic chassis and four independent wheel components. Measure ground distance at each wheel; apply spring and damper forces at each support point. Make visible wheel positions follow suspension travel. Add acceleration, steering, braking, and lateral grip.

Switch to Copper Metropolis. Build a compact quadcopter with a dynamic body, four counter-rotating rotor components, landing feet, and a marked front.

Follow the local character using their actual feet position and velocity. Maintain an offset 3.2m above, 2.5m to the side and 3.5m behind the initial forward direction. Hover when they stop; hold the last target if tracking is lost.

Use local-up thrust and attitude torque: pitch to accelerate, counter-tilt to brake, roll to move sideways. Test walking, airborne ascent, direction changes, stopping, and target loss. No timed route or pose animation.
